_approach: Robert Hood-style minimal reduction: strip the groove back to just the kick, adding a single hi-hat layer one bar later rather than a wall of percussion, in the 'Minimal Nation' ethos of making each hit count. Bar 1 is kick alone; bar 2 adds the swung closed hat back in at low velocity. No snare, no shaker, nothing else — the space is the point. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
